attempts.text:
**The window starts in a persistent spine.** Columns 0 to 10, `sseA` to `der`, are carried by 93 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, and only 0 to 5% of calls fall in a region of plasticity. The model names 95 to 100% of them, fewest at `ndk`, 95%, and hesitates most at `sseA`, 0.69 bits.

**A first fork sits at column 11**, where a zinc ribbon domain-containing protein is carried by 67% of chromosomes. Then columns 12 to 18, `xseA` to a hypothetical protein, stay persistent at 93 to 95%, with 15 to 23% of calls in a region of plasticity; the model names 83 to 97%, fewest at `yfgI`, 83%. Column 19 is a fork: `pdeF` in 89%, with an IS1-like element transposase in 14%.

**Columns 20 to 27, `ppx` to `arsC`, remain persistent** at 91 to 95%, 17 to 22% of calls in a region of plasticity, named 90 to 95%. Then columns 28 to 79 are fork and variable columns, 3 to 79% in a region of plasticity, named 63 to 97%. The most hesitant column is 38, `hyfD`, 0.85 bits, named 63%; columns 33 and 35, `hyfI` and `hyfG`, reach 0.78 bits.

**Branches run beside the main line.** Columns 35 to 37 carry a branch of 3 families, a hypothetical protein, a terminase small subunit and a terminase, each in 10 to 11% of chromosomes; columns 41 to 44 carry a hypothetical protein, a peptidase, a major capsid protein and a Bbp16 family capsid cement protein; columns 47 to 49 carry 3 hypothetical proteins; columns 74 to 76 carry `yfeY`, `yfeX` and `murP`, 10 to 17%.

**The `eut` operon, [[ethanolamine utilization]], runs from column 62 to 76**, `eutS` to `eutR`, 51 to 80% of chromosomes. The window ends at column 79, `ypeA`, in 32%. Across the window the model names 92% of genes at 0.37 bits; inside a region of plasticity it names 70% at 1.14 bits, against 98% at 0.16 bits outside.

label: sseA
facts:
WINDOW: the sseA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor sseA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,189 to 1,268 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying sseA once); 42,880 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.37 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,771 calls, named 99%, 0.15 bits; shell 8,782 calls, named 77%, 0.76 bits; cloud 1,327 calls, named 19%, 3.29 bits. Outside an RGP 33,516 calls, named 98%, 0.16 bits; inside an RGP 9,364 calls, named 70%, 1.14 bits. Columns: 26 spine, 25 fork, 29 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.14 against 0.16 bits) and names fewer genes (70% against 98%); 9,364 of the 42,880 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 38 (hyfD) 0.85 bits, RGP 73%; column 33 (hyfI) 0.78 bits, RGP 74%; column 35 (hyfG) 0.78 bits, RGP 78%. The 11 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 83%, 0.69 bits on average; the other 69 columns: named 93%, 0.32 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 28-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 3-79%; the least: columns 0-10 (spine), RGP 0-5%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-10 (11 columns) spine: share 93-100%, all P, RGP 0-5%. Genes: sseA, yfhM, pbpC, ndk, rlmN, rodZ, ispG, hisS, yfgM "ancillary SecYEG translocon subunit…", bamB, der. named 95-100% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 3 (ndk), named 95%; most hesitant at column 0 (sseA), 0.69 bits.
2. column 11 fork: RGP 22%. named 73%; 0.08 bits.
   11: yfgJ S 67% "zinc ribbon domain-containing prote…"; also "zinc ribbon domain-containing protein" S 27%
3. columns 12-18 (7 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 15-23%. Genes: xseA, guaB, guaA "glutamine-hydrolyzing GMP synthase", yfgI "DUF5384 family protein", yfgH "glycine zipper 2TM domain-containin…", yfgG "YfgG family protein", "hypothetical protein". named 83-97% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 15 (yfgI), named 83%; most hesitant at column 16 (yfgH), 0.70 bits.
4. column 19 fork: RGP 22%. named 87%; 0.74 bits.
   19: pdeF P 89%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 14%, "AlpA family transcriptional regulator" S 12%
5. columns 20-27 (8 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 17-22%. Genes: ppx, ppk1, purN "phosphoribosylglycinamide formyltra…", purM, upp, uraA, hda, arsC. named 90-95% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 20 (ppx), named 90%, 0.41 bits.
6. columns 28-79 (52 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 3-79%. named 63-97% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 38, named 63%, 0.85 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 35-37, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-11%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "terminase small subunit", "terminase"
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 41-44, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-11%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "peptidase", "major capsid protein", "Bbp16 family capsid cement protein"
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 47-49, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-11%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "hypothetical protein", "hypothetical protein"
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 74-76, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-17%, all P; the branch's families: yfeY, yfeX, murP
   28 fork: bepA P 90%; also "replication protein P" S 11%
   columns 29-34 variable, share 62-88%, 5 S, 1 P: yfgO "AI-2E family transporter" 88%, focB 62%, hyfR 72%, hyfJ 75%, hyfI "hydrogenase 4 catalytic subunit HyfI" 69%, hyfH 72%
